async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Change the target branch from 'main' to 'master'.
    # Click the 'main' button to open the target branch dropdown.
    main_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="main")

    # Select 'master' from the dropdown.
    master_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="master", exact=True)

    # Click the 'Unassigned' button to open assignee dropdown.

    # Assign myself by clicking 'Assign to me' link.
    assign_to_me_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Assign to me")
    await assign_to_me_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    
    # Re-open the assignee dropdown to assign Roshan.
    await unassigned_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Type 'Roshan' in the search input that appears in the dropdown.
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search", exact=False)
    await searchbox.fill("Roshan")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Select Roshan from the options.
    roshan_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Roshan", exact=False)
    await roshan_option.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Fill in the merge request title and description.

    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")

    # Locate the description textbox.
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description")

    # Step 4: Submit the merge request.
    # Click 'Create merge request' button.
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create merge request", exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # After submission, the task is complete.
